verdict.rationale: The docs show you can bring your own credentials: pick from many LLM providers, authenticate, and set the default model as provider/model. Credentials can also be kept out of plaintext config via SecretRefs. Community reports say Anthropic and Google have barred their consumer subscriptions from use with OpenClaw, which weakens the 'bring your subscriptions' half, and nothing in the pack shows token-usage or cost visibility. Missing for 10: token usage and cost reporting per model or per conversation, a reliable subscription-based auth path, and independent hands-on corroboration of BYO-key setup.
